product.name: StarTech 8-Outlet Horizontal Rack Mount PDU 1U Power Strip On/Off Switches
product.description: This 1U 8-Outlet Rack Mount Horizontal PDU features a built-in 8ft. (2.4m) NEMA 5-15P power cord and 8x NEMA 5-15R outlets, delivering 125V maximum input/output. With a 15A circuit breaker, this unit ensures the protection and stable operation of your critical equipment.Individual On/Off Outlet SwitchesEach outlet on the PDU is equipped with an independent/individual illuminated rocker switch, allowing for precise power management and control. The clearly enumerated switch labels make it easy to identify the switch to manage each connected device. Safety covers on the switches prevent accidental power cycling, adding an extra layer of security to the setup. This feature is particularly valuable in environments where uptime and equipment protection are paramount.15A circuit BreakerThe 1U 8-Outlet Rack Mount PDU features a robust 15 amp circuit breaker, designed to provide unparalleled protection for your connected equipment. This self-tripping and resettable breaker ensures that in the event of an overload or electrical fault, power is immediately cut off to prevent damage to your valuable devices. The 15A trip-point is precisely calibrated to handle the power demands of server rooms, data centers, and other professional IT environments, offering peace of mind and reliable operation. By swiftly interrupting the power supply in adverse conditions, this circuit breaker not only safeguards your equipment but also minimizes downtime and maintenance efforts, making it an essential component for any high-performance power distribution setup.1U Rack Mount DesignEngineered for compatibility, the 1U rack design easily installs into any 19-inch server rack that is four inches or deeper, utilizing just 1U of rack space. Adhering to ANSI/EIA RS-310-D standards, this horizontal-mount PDU is a perfect fit for any network rack, ensuring a streamlined and organized power distribution system.The PDU features an optimized design with heavy-duty steel housing and rear-facing outlets, maximizing space efficiency and durability, making it a reliable addition to any professional IT environment.
